item.title: Updated: One person seriously injured in traffic crash involving police cruiser
item.description: HYANNIS – One person was seriously injured in a traffic crash involving a Barnstable Police cruiser in Hyannis. The collision happened at Falmouth Road (Route 28) and Bearse’s Way about 10:45 PM Friday evening. Hyannis firefighters extricated a civilian from one of the vehicles who was transported to Cape Cod Hospital under a trauma alert.
